account.title: My Account
account.lead: How you appear to others on Rift.

account.disableAccountHint: Hide your profile and stop notifications. You can reactivate anytime.

profile.lead: Customize how others see your identity card.

privacy.scanMessagesHint: Filter explicit content from people you don't know.

connections.title: Connections
connections.lead: Link other accounts to enrich your messages and presence.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.lead: Theme, color, and how dense the UI feels.

voice.title: Voice & Video
voice.lead: Set up the devices and behavior for voice channels.

notifications.lead: Choose what reaches you, and when it stays quiet.

notifications.enableSoundsHint: Play a sound for messages and events.
